panic.title: You're Safe. Take a Breath.
panic.subtitle: Follow these steps right now:

step1.title: Stop sharing information
step1.detail: Hang up immediately. Do not share any OTPs, passwords, or personal details.

step2.title: Block the number or sender
step2.detail: Block the phone number, email, or account that contacted you.

step3.title: Call your bank
step3.detail: If you shared financial information, call your bank's official helpline immediately.

step4.title: Report the scam
step4.detail: Report it to your local cybercrime authority or consumer protection agency.

panic.reminder: You are not alone. Scammers are sophisticated — it's not your fault.
panic.dialFallbackMessage: Your device cannot dial numbers directly. In an emergency, call {{number}} from your phone app.
